texts.en:
An accident occurred while collecting live samples from planet [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. Due to a miscalculation, our [GetIndividualNamePlural] were equipped with tractor beams of insufficient strength. Instead of acquiring the specimen, we only managed to lift them in the air and drop them to the ground shortly after.

The avian specimens we were trying to collect found the accident highly amusing. The bolder specimens even started chasing after our [GetIndividualNamePlural] in a bid to be lifted up too, just for the thrill.

An accident occurred while collecting live samples from planet [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. Some of the specimens ended up on top of buildings and trees, baffling the locals and giving life to all sorts of weird theories.

summary.text:
# 天上正在下[pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]！ / It's Raining [pre_ftl_species.GetNamePlural]!

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12
- 来源 Sources：`events/first_contact_dlc_events.txt:4815-4939`；common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:140-201（每月观测事件池）；`events/first_contact_dlc_situation_events.txt:316-376`（preftl.50）

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 被观测的前超光速文明的“科技进步”局势每月有 5/100 的机会运行 preftl.50（之后 1800 天冷却），从每月观测事件池中按权重抽取一个条件满足的事件；本事件权重 50。
  The observed pre-FTL civilization's tech-progress situation has a 5/100 monthly chance to run preftl.50 (then an 1800-day cooldown), which draws one valid event from the monthly observation pool by weight; this event has weight 50.
- 条件：以“样本采集”任务观测（任何时代），且该文明没有进行中的观测事件链；每个前超光速文明一次。
  Conditions: observed with Specimen Collection (any age) and no ongoing pre-FTL event chain; once per pre-FTL civilization.
- 隐藏分派事件设置一次性标记，然后在 0–25 天后向观测哨站拥有者（及游牧中继站观察者）发出可见事件。
  The hidden dispatcher sets a once-only flag and sends the visible event to the observation post owner (and nomad waystation observers) after 0-25 days.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 2011「天上正在下（物种名）！」：牵引光束功率不足，抓起的个体又掉了下去。
  2011 "It's Raining (species)!": underpowered tractor beams lift specimens and drop them again.
- 选项：修理光束（需 300 合金）；（非激进干涉政策）改为被动观察；或继续并散布录像。单页事件。
  Options: fix the beams (needs 300 alloys); (not under the aggressive interference policy) switch to Passive Observation; or keep going and distribute the footage. A single window.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 这是随机观测插曲：只在满足条件时可能出现，彼此之间没有固定顺序。
  This is a random observation interlude: it may appear only when its conditions hold, with no fixed order relative to other interludes.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 正文按被观测物种是否为鸟类分两种。
  Two texts depending on whether the observed species is avian.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：触发、正文与选项条件。
  Checked: trigger, text and option conditions.
